paragraphs: Chizkiyah son of R' Parnakh — Berakhot 23a.
R' Yitzchak ben Parnakh — Kallah Rabbati, beginning of chapter 3.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: כג.. is rendered Berakhot 23a by the period convention with a terminal stop; the older doubled-mark uncertainty remains, without independent named-edition verification.
בר׳ in the first patronymic gives son of R' Parnakh; Yitzchak’s line has only ben Parnakh. No title is transferred between the two father-name occurrences or onto Chizkiyah.
רפ״ג gives beginning of chapter 3, not the earlier end-of-chapter reading. No named Kallah Rabbati witness is independently checked. Yitzchak’s abbreviated title remains R'.
